scope: Independent decoding of delivered GLB bytes. Compressed and decoded Khronos validation, canonical skeleton, weighted skin bind bounds, geometry, atlases and LOD budgets. This is neither physical-phone FPS measurement nor visual quality scoring.

distinctBodyBuilds.scope: Bind-pose central torso slab at 70–77% height. This confirms geometric differences, not subjective realism.

authoringCounters.definition: Authoring metadata is cross-checked against independently decoded triangle counts and weighted bind height; it is not the source of those measurements. The LOD silhouette may differ by up to2mm after decimation and13-bit quantization.

losslessAnimationCompression.definition: Only animation bufferViews use required EXT_meshopt_compression ATTRIBUTES with no lossy filter. Geometry, textures, weights and grip morphs retain their original Draco/sparse storage. Full before/after accessor byte identity is independently recorded by motion-export.mjs.

restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.

restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.

losslessAnimationCompression.definition: Only animation bufferViews use required EXT_meshopt_compression ATTRIBUTES with no lossy filter. Geometry, textures, weights and grip morphs retain their original Draco/sparse storage. Full before/after accessor byte identity is independently recorded by motion-export.mjs.

restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.

restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.

restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.

authoringCounters.definition: Authoring metadata is cross-checked against independently decoded triangle counts and weighted bind height; it is not the source of those measurements. The LOD silhouette may differ by up to2mm after decimation and13-bit quantization.

losslessAnimationCompression.definition: Only animation bufferViews use required EXT_meshopt_compression ATTRIBUTES with no lossy filter. Geometry, textures, weights and grip morphs retain their original Draco/sparse storage. Full before/after accessor byte identity is independently recorded by motion-export.mjs.

restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.

losslessAnimationCompression.definition: Only animation bufferViews use required EXT_meshopt_compression ATTRIBUTES with no lossy filter. restAxes.definition: +Y up and +X anatomical left, tested from named bind joints. +Z facing is confirmed by rendered face/front review.

independentGripMorphs.definition: Left/right POSITION morphs contain finite nonzero finger deformation localized to vertices weighted at least25% to the corresponding canonical Hand joint; no extra finger joints are introduced. Actual thumb/finger surface contact requires rendered and deformed-mesh checks.

gripNormalMorphs.definition: Both grip targets include finite nonzero NORMAL deltas localized to the same hand-weighted side, so curled fingers retain corrected surface shading.

singleAtlas.definition: One UV atlas layout, one base-color image and one tangent-space normal image; every sampled material uses TEXCOORD_0.

nonFlatNormalMap.definition: Normal texture has blue-facing tangent-space values and measurable XY variation, and at least one material samples it at nonzero strength. Visual cloth realism still requires rendered review.

plausibleBindBounds.definition: All weighted bind vertices lie in a finite, centered human-scale envelope; isolated far-away triangles or broken mesh transforms cannot pass merely because total height is correct.

requiredAnimationCoverage.definition: Each named action is embedded, finite, time-varying and has distinct sampled channels. This detects missing/static/byte-identical clips; rendered choreography and contact are reviewed separately.

presentationBallAnchor.definition: Exactly one nonjoint MotionBallAnchor carries reusable radius0.12m presentation trajectory in all27 clips, with scale-based visibility. Skeleton and finger morph tracks remain present; gameplay ownership/physics are outside this asset contract.

extras.purpose: Attach an unbranded basketball mesh. Position/rotation/scale are authored presentation only; scale zero means hidden. No ownership, score or physics is implied.
